WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 14. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

evidence.quote_or_excerpt:
ABOUT THE GAME

 Step into Lady Fortune’s abode and let her tell you of your future fortunes! 

 Orb of Destiny is a 6-reel, 4-row game with payline wins, featuring two bonus games and a max win of 10,000 times your bet!

 The max win can be achieved in all game modes.

 FEATURES

 LADY FORTUNE

 Lady Fortune is an expanded wild multiplier reel that displays 1 - 3 multipliers at the bottom of the reel when it lands. The total number of multipliers can be increased by landing Orb symbols, up to a maximum of 5 multipliers on each Lady Fortune.
